claims.locator: Chapter CIV (104), stanza 4, including its concluding all-planets 11th-house statement
claims.scope: Supports the configured favourable houses counted from Janma Chandra for Surya, Chandra, Mangala, Budha, Guru, Shukra and Shani. The explicit houses in stanza 4 combine with its concluding statement that all Grahas are benefic in the 11th. It does not support the Vedha table, father-son exemptions, Rahu/Ketu convention, named Shani conditions, or the binary reduction of each transit to one verdict.

claims.locator: Phaladeepika, Adhyaya XXVI, slokas 3-8 (printed pp. 287-289); Jataka Parijata, Volume III, Adhyaya XIII, note to sloka 60, printed pp. 833-834 (PDF pp. 127-128)
claims.scope: Supports every configured favourable-house-to-Vedha-house pair for Surya, Chandra, Kuja, Budha, Guru, Shukra and Shani, plus the Surya-Shani and Chandra-Budha exemptions. It does not support this project's Rahu/Ketu policy or named Shani conditions. Brihat Samhita Chapter 104 is not the authority for this layer.

claims.locator: Phaladeepika, Adhyaya XXVI, sloka 2 (printed p. 286), especially the concluding direction that Rahu and Ketu are similar to Surya
claims.scope: The implementation gives Rahu and Ketu Shani's favourable houses (3, 6 and 11) and therefore marks the 10th adverse. Phaladeepika 26.2 directs that both nodes be treated like Surya, whose favourable set is 3, 6, 10 and 11. This directly contradicts the implemented favourable-house set. The passage does not establish whether nodes cause or receive Vedha, so the separate no-Vedha policy remains unverified rather than contradicted by this locator.

claims.locator: Phaladeepika, Adhyaya XXVI, sloka 1 for Janma Chandra as the transit reference and slokas 22-23 (printed pp. 295-296) for Shani's effects in houses 1, 2, 4, 8 and 12
claims.scope: Verifies that these five Shani positions are reckoned from the natal Moon and have adverse classical transit effects. It does not verify grouping houses 12, 1 and 2 under the vernacular name Sade Sati; the names Ashtama Shani and Ardhastama Shani; the rising, peak and setting phase labels; or the deterministic advice sentences. Those remain configured conventional or project-interpreted presentation layers.

The generator verifies the rasi set and every declared graha, house and verdict in transits_cited against computed gochara. The text and advice fields are model interpretation: they are screened for unsupported precision and selected high-stakes directions but are not semantically or scripturally verified. They must never inherit the authority state of their cited transit triples.
Each activity needs rule-level locators; shared defaults must not imply universal textual agreement.

claims.locator: Chapter IX, 'Electing a time for marriage,' printed p. 41 (PDF p. 45), especially the Tithi, Vara, Nakshatra and Rasi rules
claims.scope: The inspected passage contradicts the configured wedding Tithi-family scoring. The project penalizes every Jaya Tithi, but Raman names Shukla Tritiya and Trayodashi among the best while rejecting Ashtami. The project rewards every Purna Tithi, which can reward Pournami and Amavasya even though the passage rejects both. Raman also supplies exact weekday, Nakshatra and rising-Rasi lists that the current broad preferences do not represent. This audit claim records evidence debt only and must never be presented as a verified profile.

claims.locator: Chapter XII, 'House Building' / 'Laying the Foundation,' printed p. 50 (PDF p. 54)
claims.scope: Supports the configured house-foundation lunar-month, Tithi-number, Nakshatra, weekday, solar-Rasi and fixed-Lagna criteria. Full election-chart house occupancy/aspects and ritual site placement are disclosed manual checks. Shared samskara filters, personal scoring and relative tiers require separate authority.

claims.locator: Chapter VIII, 'Post-natal ceremonies' / 'Naming the child (Namakarana),' printed p. 21 (PDF p. 25)
claims.scope: Supports the configured Namakarana weekday and Nakshatra admission lists, rejected Tithi numbers, fixed-Lagna preference, timing-after-birth guidance and disclosed election-chart/name checks. Shared samskara filters, Choghadiya and Tithi-family ranking bonuses, personal scoring and relative tiers require separate authority.

claims.locator: Chapter VIII, 'Post-natal ceremonies' / 'First feeding on rice (Annaprasana),' printed pp. 21-22 (PDF pp. 25-26); general Panchanga Suddhi Tithis, Chapter V, printed p. 11 (PDF p. 15)
claims.scope: Supports the configured Annaprasana Nakshatra and weekday admission lists, rejected general-Panchanga-Suddhi Tithis, excluded rising Rasis, age-month guidance and disclosed election-chart checks. Shared samskara filters, Choghadiya and Tithi-family ranking bonuses, personal scoring and relative tiers require separate authority.

claims.locator: Chapter VIII, 'Post-natal ceremonies' / 'Ear boring (Karnavedha),' printed p. 22 (PDF p. 26); general Panchanga Suddhi Tithis, Chapter V, printed p. 11 (PDF p. 15)
claims.scope: Supports the daytime-only rule, admitted weekdays, rejected rising Rasis, age guidance, double-Tithi/double-Nakshatra caution, vacant-8th requirement and general-Panchanga-Suddhi Tithi exclusions. Age, transition-count and election-house checks remain manual. Shared samskara filters, Tithi-family ranking, personal scoring and relative tiers require separate authority.

claims.locator: Chapter VIII, 'Post-natal ceremonies' / 'Tonsure (Chowlam),' printed pp. 22-23 (PDF pp. 26-27)
claims.scope: Supports the configured Shukla-Paksha, forenoon, combustion, Tithi, weekday, Nakshatra and conservative rising-Rasi rules plus disclosed age, pregnancy, solar-season and election-chart checks. Shared samskara filters, Tithi-family ranking, personal scoring and relative tiers require separate authority.

claims.locator: Chapter VIII, 'Post-natal ceremonies' / 'Commencing education (Aksharabhyasa),' printed p. 23 (PDF p. 27)
claims.scope: Supports the configured Vidyarambha weekday, Nakshatra and movable-or-common rising-Rasi admission lists plus disclosed age, forenoon/noon and election-chart guidance. Shared samskara filters, Choghadiya and Tithi-family ranking, personal scoring and relative tiers require separate authority.

claims.locator: Chapter VIII, 'Post-natal ceremonies' / 'Investiture of sacred thread (Upanayanam),' printed pp. 23-24 (PDF pp. 27-28)
claims.scope: Supports the configured Upanayana lunar months, Uttarayana solar Rasis, exact Paksha-qualified Tithis, weekdays, Nakshatras, admitted rising Rasis and before-noon rule plus disclosed age, conditional Budha combustion and election-chart checks. Shared samskara filters, Tithi-family ranking, personal scoring and relative tiers require separate authority.

claims.locator: Chapter IV, 'Influence of Nakshatras,' movable-Nakshatra classification, printed p. 10 (PDF p. 14)
claims.scope: Supports only the configured +1 preference for five movable Nakshatras when acquiring vehicles; the passage does not reject every other Nakshatra. The Labh-Choghadiya, Bhadra-Tithi, Friday and fixed-Lagna ranking preferences are disclosed project rules and do not inherit authority from this citation.

claims.locator: Chapter XII, 'Digging Wells,' printed p. 51 (PDF p. 55)
claims.scope: Supports the configured well-digging Nakshatra and rising-Rasi admission lists plus the disclosed Surya-in-Lagna hard-rock caution. Shukra/Chandra Kendra placement and the abundant-sweet-water condition remain manual chart checks. Shared ranking and personal factors require separate authority.

claims.locator: Chapter XII, 'Laying the Foundation,' roofing-stage instruction, printed p. 50 (PDF p. 54)
claims.scope: Supports only the configured Vrishabha-or-Tula rising-Rasi admission rule for roofing. The passage distinguishes roofing from foundation laying but supplies no separate weekday, Tithi or Nakshatra list for this stage. The Panchaka-Nakshatra restriction is a separately implemented project rule and does not inherit authority from this citation.

claims.locator: Chapter XVI, 'Electing Head of the State' and 'Coronation,' printed p. 66 (PDF p. 70)
claims.scope: The coronation paragraph explicitly applies the immediately preceding head-of-state rules. This supports the configured Nakshatra, exact Tithi and admitted rising-Rasi lists plus the disclosed election-chart checks and the traditional-coronation and democratic-government alternatives. Shared samskara exclusions and the Urdhva-Mukha preference are separately implemented project rules and do not inherit authority from this citation.

claims.locator: Chapter XIII, 'Felling Trees,' printed p. 58 (PDF p. 62)
claims.scope: Supports felling trees during Chandra's last quarter, represented by Krishna Ashtami through Amavasya, and the disclosed dry-Rasi/dry-Graha chart check. The Panchaka-Nakshatra restriction is a separately implemented project rule and does not inherit authority from this citation.

claims.locator: Chapter XV, 'Surgical Operations,' printed pp. 64-65 (PDF pp. 68-69)
claims.scope: Supports the configured Tuesday-or-Saturday, waxing Chaturthi/Navami/Chaturdashi and Ardra/Jyeshtha/Ashlesha/Moola admission rules plus the disclosed natal-Chandra, operated-body-part, Mangala, 8th-house, relevant-house and Mangala-Shani chart checks. The Vishti-Karana rejection is a separately implemented project rule and does not inherit authority from this citation. Medical urgency and clinician instructions always override electional timing.

claims.locator: Chapter X, 'Buying Jewelry,' printed p. 45 (PDF p. 49)
claims.scope: Supports only the disclosed requirement that Surya and Chandra be well situated and aspected, plus the passage's general instruction to avoid unfavorable Tithis and Nakshatras. It does not supply a jewelry-specific weekday, Tithi, Nakshatra, Lagna or Choghadiya list. The configured Labh-Choghadiya, Bhadra-Tithi, Friday/Thursday and fixed-Lagna preferences are disclosed project heuristics and do not inherit authority from this citation.

claims.locator: Chapter XIV, 'Journeys' and 'Pilgrimage,' printed pp. 60-62 (PDF pp. 64-66)
claims.scope: The pilgrimage paragraph explicitly incorporates the earlier journey rules. This supports rejecting Chaturdashi and Full/New Chandra days, preferring the ten named journey Nakshatras, rejecting Guru combustion and disclosing Guru-in-Lagna-or-9th as a chart check. The Vishti-Karana rejection follows the separately cited general Panchanga-Suddhi rule. The configured Chara-Lagna preference is a project heuristic and does not inherit authority from this citation; Raman instead names six individual favorable journey Rasis.

claims.locator: Chapter XIV, 'Journeys' and 'Long-distance Journeys,' printed pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 64-65)
claims.scope: Supports configured hard rejection of Bharani/Krittika, preference for the ten named journey Nakshatras, and the disclosed Lagna, Guru/Shukra, waxing-Chandra, Mangala and 7th-house chart checks. Vishti rejection follows the separately cited general Panchanga-Suddhi rule. Chara-Lagna and Tiryan-Mukha bonuses are separately attributed project rules. Two source corrections remain outside the configured claim because existing tests pin contrary behavior: Chaturdashi/Full/New Chandra rejection, and time-of-day exceptions to Disha Shoola. Both require explicit owner approval.

claims.locator: Chapter XII, 'Buying Lands for Buildings,' printed p. 53 (PDF p. 57)
claims.scope: Supports the configured building-land purchase weekday and Nakshatra admission lists, hard Rikta-Tithi rejection and fixed-Lagna preference. Weekday-lord, Guru, Mangala and house-lord placement conditions remain manual checks. It does not support elections for purchasing a completed house, which Raman treats separately.
